clips.title: The story
paras: Near Heroes' Vigil in Elwynn Forest, Henze Faulk lies gravely wounded. He shielded his companion Gazin Tenorm from the Defias Brotherhood, and now awaits a paladin's aid.

Henze Faulk lies near the stone ring east of Stormwind, at Heroes' Vigil. Defias marauders ambushed him and his friend Gazin Tenorm there. Henze took the attack so Gazin could survive, and fell to the bandits' blades. Gazin reached the Cathedral of Light to seek help. Henze remains between life and death, awaiting the aid of a paladin carrying a Symbol of Life.
